description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates the use of ColorMatrix and color filters to modify bitmap images dynamically. It includes methods to adjust contrast and color translation effects on the bitmap displayed in the view.

classes.name: ColorMatrixSample
classes.description: Main activity class that initializes the sample view for displaying color matrix effects.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: Custom View class that performs the drawing of bitmaps and applies various color transformations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Android activity lifecycle method that sets up the content view.

methods.name: setTranslate
methods.description: Configures a ColorMatrix to translate color components by specified amounts.

methods.name: setContrast
methods.description: Configures a ColorMatrix to adjust the contrast based on a contrast value.

methods.name: setContrastTranslateOnly
methods.description: Configures a ColorMatrix to only adjust translation (brightness) without scaling.

methods.name: setContrastScaleOnly
methods.description: Configures a ColorMatrix to only adjust scaling (contrast) without translation.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Override method to draw bitmaps with different color filters applied.
